translation.name: Waom Yesu Wane Sigi Maep Don

content: Lama Siuk Siukinane Don Rokop
Naso maneo takis mama so borikine mama loutneŋo Yesu wane don desikei wane sarikoi.
Pakiso, Anutu papa togon welaine ŋei, Parisi so Skribe eŋe kieke more detpi boriki, Yesu wane rakoi, “Ŋei iwa eŋe borikine mama kima okanon okanmaike, so eŋerop weneŋ mere ŋara ne okanmaike!”
Pakimo, ea wane Yesuŋo don rokop mane iwa yale edange,

“Ŋinano ŋine mane eŋe lamakoune 100 okorakei, pakimo yewa ŋine weku siukeake, siukkimo, lama welaine eŋe daleo okaniake? Eŋe qeliŋongi, lama 99 yewa ŋaraene ne okorau mo, eŋine lamawa mane siukike, ea wane zuage ari mage maratkayake.
Maratkayake, naso yewao welaine eŋe zok wet pesek suaine dere more lamaine yewa ma biraki wokine kutno wayake.
Wakimo, teweke matko ma ariake, ariki paki, kimakoune so matkoune edoraki sari lewageu edane rayake, ‘Na wet pesek suaine detmaile, lamane siukkeo ŋine koso maratkamaile, ea wane ŋene bakom kitoŋem!’

Na ŋidanbe detpi, rokop yalewaka weti qeliwo eŋe bakom okanikei, yemo ŋei 99, eŋe menaŋgoi, ŋo wetene zok mi maingelukkei. Ŋo siluŋ borikine mama wekukurapŋo wetne maingemaike, yemo oi bakom suaine weti qeliwo wakoniake.
Wesi Siu Siukine Ea Wane Don Saeŋine
“Me ŋerep maneŋo wesi setne 10 ma geake, yewa ŋine weku siukki mo, ŋereppae eŋe daleo okaniake? Eŋe kiwa kiwakki lawekimo qelaŋango maine sino kitoki paki, yewao yewao kaululke zuage ari maratkayake.
Maratka more, kimakoune so matkoune edoraki sari lewageu edane rayake, ‘Na wetne zok pesemaike, wesine setne weku siukike, ea mo marat kamaile, ea wane ŋene bakom kitoŋem!’
Na ŋidanbe detpi, rokop yale waka Anutu wane aŋelokoune eŋe borikine mama wekukuŋo wetne maingeki, oi bakom suaine okanikei.”
Medep Mane Magaine Qeliŋka More Arike Ea Wane Don Kisi
Yesu eŋe koso takotke more rake, “Ŋei mane eŋe gipoletkine etke gekoik.
Gipole nigatneŋo magaine olale rake, ‘Magak, wesi aboŋba naŋane biŋek, yewa ukude mapoke ninnom.’ Rakiso ŋei wae eŋe wesi aboŋ yewa keuoka mapoke gipole nigatne ea mane mange.

Kaiwe urata mama ewekine mere, so gipole nigatne eŋe kine kine kakiine natne yewa matoke qolewareke, pakiso wesiine yewa ma so matine ea qelige, so kepe mane abaran yewao ari geke. Ge more wawaine okane more, wesi yewa korop qakki ariwareke.
Ari mage mida lelemaike, rakimo kepe wa geke, yewao bodi kakapa suaine wakone, kepe mat yewa rokopke pake, pakiso medeppae eŋe mo ea wesi aboŋine midaine metke.
Mere ari kepe mat yewa wane welaine ŋei mane eŋano urata mayakane wakonge. Pakiso, ŋeiwaeŋo birakaki ari berek sengo berewekoune wareonge.
Berek eŋe bese wane solaine neu, ŋei eŋe yalewaka bese wane solaine yewa neakane wekemaŋke, ŋo ŋei maneŋo ŋara mane mi mangi neke.
Ŋado wetine lotkeki, detwareki paki rake, ‘Maganane urata mama ŋeikoune korop, eŋe ŋara zok suaine neu ŋatene qemaike, ŋo na iwa mere zok ŋara wane seukmaile,
ea wane na baŋ wie more maganano ariwe paki olale raikale, Magak, na borikine mawe, Anutu ŋabakamaike, so ge weneŋ ŋaba ganmaike,
na ŋei maine mida, ea wane ge naŋane giponne misuk raikene, ge urata mama ŋeiŋone yale biranannom gekale.’

Yale raki pakiso, wie more magainano zinge arike. Ari mat osino osino raki, magaineŋo mo potki ariki kake, ka more wet borikŋo kotino watkeki, biririke ari meterekine biraki ariki, gipole masatka more lulukike.
Pakiso gipoleŋo olatke, ‘Magak, na borikine mawe, Anutu ŋabakamaike, so ge weneŋ ŋabaganmaike, ea wane na koso geŋane giponŋone misuk norakene.’

Ŋo magaineŋo yemo qelit ŋeikoune edoraki sariu edane rake, ‘Ikop ariu! Ari naewo ŋine takot musele kiroine mane ma sari, birakau ketkep. So metino siliwa zale mane birau wetekimo, kieretkino kie tabe weneŋ birau wakep.
Pakimo, ari bulamakau medeune mane kelokinerop yewa qe more mitpi, epa waom ma neŋem paki, bakom kitoŋem!
Medep iwa eŋe mo seukkeo ŋine, koso siluŋ marat kamaine.’ Yale ra edangiso, epa waom ma neso, oi bakom kieke okangoi.
Gipole suaine eŋe naso yewao euo geke, yewao ŋine koso zinge sari mat osino okora, eŋet so wagom yewa detke.
Dere more qelit ŋei mane oraki sariki qesonka rake, ‘Iwa daleo okanmami?’

Qelit ŋeiŋo olale rake, ‘Geŋane ŋonŋone mo matko zinge sarike, pakimo magaŋoneŋo bulamakau medeune kelokinerop mane qemaike, gipole kine kine maneŋo mi matalikake, maineka sarike, ea wane, magaŋitneŋo raki okanmami,’
Tatine suaine eŋe sotine osiki mat koto mi wake, pakiso magaineŋo saket more, mat koto wayakane wetkelik kake.

Ŋo gipoleŋo yemo done turuŋine olale rake, ‘Detnom, na koma loutne urata ŋei yauwine yale qelitŋone qe sarikole, donŋone mane mi qekole, ge onokaka mane ningone? Ge noniŋ mida mane mi ninnom qe more kimakopne eŋerop epa waom ma neŋem paki, oi bakom okangone, midakaka!
Ŋo giponŋone iwa eŋe yemo wesi aboŋŋone korop yewa wenip ŋerep eŋerop ge more, mataliwareki mida leleki, koso zinge matko sarikimo, ge bulamakau medeune kelokinerop yewa eŋane qemaine!’
Yale rakimo, magaineŋo mainge olale rake, ‘Giponne, ge yemo naso baŋem narop iwa ge okanmaine, yalinane mo kine kine naŋano pamaike, ea mo geŋane okanmaike,
ŋo ŋene yemo epa waom ma neŋem paki oi bakom okanikene, ŋonŋone mo seukeo ŋine, koso siluŋ wisikaemaike, eŋe mo siukkeo ŋine, koso siluŋ wakongi marat kamaine.’”
